# CineWindows v1.0.4

## Critical Bug Fixes

- **Open Folder crash fixed**: Loading folders with large numbers of media files no longer freezes or crashes the application. Files are now loaded in batches (50 at a time) with a 10ms yield between batches, keeping the GTK main loop responsive. A 500-file per-folder limit prevents memory exhaustion from recursive scans of massive directory trees.

- **Concurrent folder load guard**: Rapidly clicking "Open Folder" multiple times no longer starts overlapping scan+load threads, preventing race conditions that could corrupt the mpv playlist or crash the process.

- **Second mpv instance (preview player) memory leak fixed**: The thumbnail preview player mpv process is now properly terminated on window close (`do_close_request`), preventing orphaned decoder processes from accumulating memory.

- **Error handling hardened**: All mpv property observers and event callbacks (`start-file`, `end-file`, `zoom-change`, etc.) now wrap mpv access in `try/except mpv.ShutdownError`, preventing cascading crashes when mpv is shutting down during rapid file transitions.

- **mpv.stop() wrapped**: Calling `stop()` on an already-idle mpv core no longer risks a crash.

- **`do_open` (file association / CLI open) hardened**: Opening files via Windows "Open with" or command line now catches `mpv.ShutdownError` and `RuntimeError` gracefully. Only actively playing windows are paused instead of blindly pausing all windows.

- **Window pause logic fixed**: When opening new files, only non-idle windows are paused (instead of all windows), preventing unnecessary interruption of playback in background windows.

- **Removed Unix-only `os.getuid()` call**: The playlist splice function used `os.getuid()` (Unix-only) inside a portal-path check. Removed the portal check entirely since CineWindows is Windows-native.

## Stability

- **GSK renderer changed to Cairo**: The GSK renderer default on Windows has been changed from `gl` to `cairo`. Cairo is the most compatible renderer — it works on all GPUs (including problematic Intel/NVIDIA combinations) and eliminates the transparent window rendering glitches that the GL renderer could cause on certain hardware. GTK will fall back to its own defaults if Cairo is unavailable. The `CINE_GSK_RENDERER` environment variable still allows overriding to `vulkan`, `gl`, `ngl`, or `cairo`.

- **Version bumped to 1.0.4**: All version metadata (constants, pyproject.toml, NSIS installer, Windows launcher .rc) updated.
